The '''1952 German football championship''' was the culmination of the [[Association football|football]] season in the [[West Germany]] in [[1951–52 Oberliga|1951–52]]. [[VfB Stuttgart]] were crowned champions for the second time after a group stage and a final, having previously won the championship in [[1950 German football championship|1950]].<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitchamp.html (West) Germany -List of champions] rsssf.org, accessed: 21 December 2015</ref><ref>[http://www.weltfussball.de/teams/vfb-stuttgart/1/ VfB Stuttgart » Steckbrief] {{in lang|de}} Weltfussball.de – VfB Stuttgart honours, accessed: 21 December 2015</ref>
